$notes: ARKit face-mesh vertex indices for the anatomical points the metrics need. ARKit publishes no semantic index map, so these are found empirically with the Debug › Vertex Picker screen (tap a point on your own mesh, it prints the index) and are STABLE across devices because the mesh topology is fixed.
null = not yet picked; the HeuristicLandmarker's geometric estimate is used instead and the point's confidence is reduced to 0.75.

Points the ARKit mesh cannot provide: trichion (hairline — mesh stops mid-forehead), cervical point / neck (not in mesh), tragus (ear, not in mesh). Those metrics stay suppressed until the appearance layer or a profile capture supplies them.
Spike 1 task: fill every null, then run tools/cv_analysis.py on the dumps.
